mapper.select: SELECT c.product_id AS productId, c.view_count AS viewCount FROM product_view_count c WHERE c.product_id IN #{productId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO product_view_count (product_id, view_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{productId}, #{delta}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + #{delta}, update_time = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM product_view_count WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_view_history h WHERE h.product_id = product_view_count.product_id)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_view_count (product_id, view_count, create_time, update_time) SELECT h.product_id, COUNT(*), NOW(), NOW() FROM product_view_history h GROUP BY h.product_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = VALUES(view_count), update_time = NOW()
